name: integrity-anchor-evidence
description: Anchor every captured evidence record into the tamper-evident integrity ledger, so its existence and ordering can later be proven with a Merkle inclusion proof and can never be silently edited or deleted. Append-only: it writes to the integrity log alone and never mutates the evidence/incident tables, so it cannot feed back into itself.

name: integrity-anchor-incident-open
description: Anchor each newly opened incident into the integrity ledger, recording that it existed at this point in the verifiable timeline. Notification/record-only; performs no moderation and does not modify the incident.

name: integrity-anchor-incident-update
description: Anchor each incident status change into the integrity ledger so the whole lifecycle (open -> triaged -> resolved ...) is provably append-only. Record-only.
